expectations.text: In the rendered DOM for both English and Finnish, every number-unit pair in the table (weight, battery, storage, display, battery life, price) is joined by U+00A0 or U+202F, never a plain U+0020
expectations.evidence: Rendered EN and FI: every number-unit pair joined by U+00A0 ('1.24\u00a0kg', '13,6\u00a0tuumaa', '1\u00a0Tt', '1\u00a0899\u00a0\u20ac'); no U+0020 between a number and its unit.

expectations.text: The Finnish rendering uses decimal commas (1,24 and 99,5) and groups the prices with a no-break space (1 299 €)
specs.html sets the numeric cells with tabular-nums
expectations.evidence: CSS `table { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; }`; computed on every td 'lining-nums tabular-nums'.

expectations.text: specs.html sets the html lang attribute to fi when Finnish is selected
expectations.evidence: After clicking the 'Suomi' button, html lang === 'fi' (render() sets documentElement.lang).

expectations.text: specs.html uses logical properties for text layout (no margin-left/right, padding-left/right, text-align: left/right, left/right offsets)
expectations.evidence: Physical properties in text layout: `thead th { text-align: right; }`, `thead th:first-child { text-align: left; }`, `tbody td { text-align: right; }`, sticky `left: 0;`, plus margin-bottom/border-bottom.

expectations.text: In the rendered DOM for both languages, the battery-life qualifier (up to / jopa) is bound to its number with a no-break space, so it cannot be stranded at a line end
expectations.evidence: Rendered EN cell is 'up\u0020to\u00a018\u00a0h': the qualifier itself contains a plain U+0020, so 'up' can be stranded at a line end (only 'to' is bound to the number); FI 'jopa\u00a018\u00a0h' is fine.
